title: Changelog top-up since 1.4.1, and the H3 step count the Turbo tooltip still gets wrong
description: Two leftovers from the sessions that shipped MPI-550/551. (1) UNRELEASED.md only carries MPI-545 - the 21:9 cinematic ratio and the H3 non-turbo quality lift were never folded in. MPI-546 (agent HTTP dispatch) is deliberately excluded: unfinished and untested, so it is not a user-facing note yet. (2) MPI-550 moved the H3 non-turbo path from 20 to 25 steps, but the Turbo button info string still tells users 6 steps instead of 20, and two code comments repeat the old number.
